name: The Infinite Staircase of Mirror‑Held Sunsets
description: A never‑ending staircase made entirely of mirrored surfaces, each step reflecting a different sunset hue, leading upward into a sky of swirling colors, observers see infinite reflections.
prompt: Infinite staircase constructed from polished mirrors, each step reflecting a unique sunset color palette, leading upwards into a sky of swirling orange, pink, and purple clouds, endless repetition effect, fantasy, ethereal, ultra-detailed, dreamlike.
caption: Walk the staircase of endless sunsets 🌅🪟 Each step paints a new slice of wonder.
